build_GNet_generator: build a progressive GAN generator network with GNet using a specified latent dimension and initial scale depth
build_DNet_discriminator: build a progressive GAN discriminator network with DNet using a specified initial scale depth and input dimensions
addScale_GNet: add a new resolution scale to the GNet generator to double the output image size
addScale_DNet: add a new resolution scale to the DNet discriminator to handle higher resolution input images
setNewAlpha_GNet: set the alpha blending factor on the GNet generator to smoothly merge outputs between resolution scales
